title: Design direction: publication front page (not a catalogue or a report)
recommendation: Lead with the products, then guides. Keep the verification process one click away. Use editorial type, a clear grid, and no generated-looking filler.
rationale: The brief asks the site to read as a polished affiliate publication. Process and audit content should sit behind the product listings.

title: Outbound link strategy
recommendation: Keep the supplied short links, marked sponsored, until the Associates test (Q-02) is complete. Then replace each one with a validated Special Link, product by product.
rationale: Changing links before the test risks breaking attribution. The current short links are not declared invalid (FLG-003).

title: Analytics and click measurement
recommendation: Choose a hosting method for an endpoint before adding any tracking. A static site cannot run a self-hosted endpoint.
rationale: Without measurement, guide topics cannot be chosen from data (SUG-04). Privacy rules depend on the tool chosen.

options.cons: Third-party processing; check its terms and disclosure needs

title: Publishing cadence and topic selection
recommendation: Publish one guide every two weeks for the first eight weeks. Choose each next topic from measured clicks and searches, not instinct.
rationale: The four working titles are hypotheses (FLG-011). Choosing topics from data is what the brief asks for.

options.label: Monthly
options.cons: Little signal in a short period

title: Product data source
recommendation: Record price, rating and availability from an authorised source with a date, for each ASIN, before any comparison.
rationale: These fields are currently blank (FLG-006). A comparison without them would be a guess.

options.label: Official Associates product data access, if the account qualifies
options.cons: Eligibility and terms must be checked first (not verified in this session)

title: Niche and product expansion
recommendation: Set written selection criteria (for example: source-verified specifications, a clear buyer question, a relevant Associates category) before adding products.
rationale: The brief asks for niche research, but no demand, competition or commission data exists yet.

title: Imagery
recommendation: Use owner-licensed photography or the product images allowed by the Associates program, after a licensing check. Until then, use typographic cards.
rationale: Stock or scraped images are a rights risk. The rights terms for Amazon-supplied images must be checked in the Program Policies (SRC-PP, not fully reviewed).
